text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1875-630, Satin Stainless Commercial Backdoor Pull For Use with a Deadbolt

The Pull Trim for Deadbolt installs easily under a deadbolt to provide a door pull without having to drill any extra holes in the door. This Satin Stainless Steel Door Pull is most often used on commercial back doors.

Features and Specifications of the Don Jo 1875-630 Under Deadbolt Door Pull:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Width: 3"
  • Length: 4-7/16"
  • Projection 3/4"
  • Hole Cut Out Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Thickness: 1/8"
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Don-Jo 1875 Door Pull Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
